background_image_description: A solid light gray background fills the frame. The surface appears uniform and featureless, with no discernible texture, patterns, or objects.

nodes.asset_description: A Renaissance portrait of a seated woman with a faint smile, hands crossed, centered against a hazy mountainous landscape. Muted earth tones and soft sfumato shading give the scene a serene, balanced composition.

A single stem with several green leaves extends diagonally across the frame against a light gray-green background. The leaves are arranged linearly along the stem, with some appearing slightly lighter or darker due to lighting. The stem is smooth and slender, connecting the leaves in a continuous line. No other objects or text are visible in the image.

A single green plant branch with several leaves extends diagonally across the image. The leaves are various shades of green and appear to grow from thin stems. The background is a light gradient transitioning from white to pale green.
